title: The clear-shifts question appears only for the old lead's unfinished shifts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · Schedule access · about 40 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Three eligible technicians at this location: [Tech-A] "Esther Howard", [Tech-B] (e.g. "Ralph Edwards"), [Tech-C] "Dana Ortiz". A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Only Unfinished" (used by this case only) with six Approved work orders led by [Tech-A], each with a line "Line 1", known by the letters A, B, C, D, E and F.
  • Shifts on the Schedule: A - [Tech-A] tomorrow 8:00–12:00, entire work order · B - no shifts at all · C - [Tech-A] tomorrow 8:00–12:00, Line 1 only · D - [Tech-A] yesterday 8:00–12:00, entire work order (already ended) · E - [Tech-C] tomorrow 8:00–12:00, entire work order · F - none of its own, while [Tech-A] has a shift on a different work order (not F) tomorrow 13:00–15:00.
  • Esther Howard and Dana Ortiz are named in the expected results and stay as written; the letters A–F are how the expected results refer to the work orders; the numbers are examples.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] = "Esther Howard" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-B] (e.g. Ralph Edwards), [Tech-C] = "Dana Ortiz" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Only Unfinished" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Only Unfinished": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • Six work orders, each with a line "Line 1" and Lead Technician = [Tech-A]. Write down each number against its letter: A (e.g. S1-701), B (S1-702), C (S1-703), D (S1-704), E (S1-705), F (S1-706).
  6. Line names in this case (such as "Line 1") are only labels for you: the New Line form's "What Are You Doing?" box only offers ready-made lines (typed text finds no results), so pick any ready-made line for each one (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot") and write down which is which.
  7. On the Schedule, give [Tech-A] a shift on A tomorrow 8:00–12:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto [Tech-A]'s row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order > set the end time > save.
  8. B has no shifts at all.
  9. On the Schedule, give [Tech-A] a shift on C tomorrow 8:00–12:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto [Tech-A]'s row at the start time > in the picker choose Choose lines and tick Line 1 > set the end time > save.
  10. On the Schedule, give [Tech-A] a shift on D yesterday 8:00–12:00 (already ended): Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto [Tech-A]'s row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order > set the end time > save.
  11. On the Schedule, give [Tech-C] a shift on E tomorrow 8:00–12:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto [Tech-C]'s row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order > set the end time > save.
  12. On the Schedule, give [Tech-A] a shift on a different work order (not F) tomorrow 13:00–15:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto [Tech-A]'s row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order > set the end time > save.
  13. Check the setup worked: Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Only Unfinished" on Work Orders > All shows A–F, all led by [Tech-A]; the Schedule shows the shifts listed above and nothing else on A–F. If a shift is missing or extra, fix it before starting, then clear the search.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Only Unfinished" in Search.
  3. Drag A from [Tech-A]'s column into [Tech-B]'s column and note whether a prompt opens (if it does, click Keep shifts).
  4. Do the same, one at a time, for B, C, D, E and F.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Only A opens the "Clear Esther Howard's scheduled shifts?" prompt (1 of 6).
  • B (no shift), C (only a line shift), D (only an ended shift), E (only Dana Ortiz's shift) and F (Esther Howard's shift is on another work order) change lead straight away with "Lead technician updated" and no prompt (5 of 6).

What you should see today (build v26.40.8-7a95011, 10/8/2026): changing the lead (by dragging the card or with Reassign lead technician) shows no question about scheduled shifts, even when the outgoing lead has a shift booked for the entire work order. The lead changes at once with the "Lead technician updated" (or "Lead technician removed") message, and the outgoing lead's shift stays on the Schedule. (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results above say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R28, read 8 Oct 2026. PO answer to engineering, Sasha Grosman 24 Sep 2026 (only the outgoing lead's whole-work-order shifts that haven't ended). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R28: “The shift-clearing prompt (S4-R11, S4-R26) shows only when the outgoing lead has a work-order-level shift on this work order that has not ended.”
  • Tech plan §1.4 (FF-4 shift scope): “Confirmed: only the outgoing lead's whole-work-order shifts that have not ended”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
